pyq_focus: Is unit se NET mein sabse zyada 'kisne likha / kis saal' wale sawal aate hain: Macaulay's Minute (2 Feb 1835), Wood's Despatch (1854), Charter Act (1813).
Commissions aur unke chairman (Hunter 1882, Raleigh 1902, Sadler 1917-19, Radhakrishnan 1948-49, Kothari 1964-66) ka match-the-following bahut common hai.
Kachru ke Three Circles (Inner, Outer, Expanding) aur India = Outer Circle, norm-developing - ye almost har saal kisi na kisi roop mein aata hai.
Indian English ke features (isn't it?, itself, only, prepone, reduplication) aur Hobson-Jobson jaise words par direct sawal aate hain.
Writers aur unki books ka match: Derozio, Toru Dutt, Naidu, Ezekiel, Ramanujan, Kamala Das, Mahapatra, Kolatkar; novelists Anand, Narayan, Raja Rao.
Novel ke characters (Bakha, Munoo, Raju, Moorthy, Saleem Sinai, Velutha, Balram) aur opening lines / famous quotes pucche jaate hain.
Translation wale hisse se: translator-text pairs (Samskara - Ramanujan, Draupadi - Spivak, Karukku - Holmstrom) aur theorists (Devy, Niranjana, Sujit Mukherjee).
Awards: pehla Sahitya Akademi English winner (Narayan), pehla poet (Mahapatra), pehla playwright (Dattani), Booker aur International Booker winners - chronology bhi banti hai.
Taiyari ka tareeka: har topic ki saal wali list banao, chronology roz ek baar padho, aur match-the-following ke liye author-work-character teeno ek saath yaad karo.

easy.title: Colonial Language Policy: Charter Act 1813 to Macaulay's Minute 1835
easy.story: Socho ek school ke paas thoda sa paisa aaya aur do teacher lad rahe hain ki bachchon ko Sanskrit padhayein ya English. Charter Act 1813 ne pehli baar padhai ke liye ek lakh rupaye saal ke rakhe. Orientalists bole Sanskrit, Arabic, Persian padhao; Anglicists bole English padhao. Raja Ram Mohan Roy ne 1823 mein Lord Amherst ko letter likh kar Western science aur English maangi. Phir Macaulay ne 2 February 1835 ko apna Minute likha aur kaha ki ek European library ki ek shelf poore Indian aur Arabic sahitya ke barabar hai. Lord Bentinck ne 7 March 1835 ko English Education Act laga diya. Plan tha ki upar ke kuch log English seekhein aur gyaan neeche 'filter' ho - jaise chhanni se paani tapakta hai.
easy.trick: '1813 ka lakh, 1823 ka letter, 1835 ka Minute' - 13, 23, 35 ko 'ek lakh, ek letter, ek Macaulay' bolo. Macaulay = 'Mac ka Minute, Feb ka do'.

easy.title: Wood's Despatch 1854 and Later Commissions
easy.story: Wood's Despatch ek bade principal ki chitthi jaisa hai jisne poori school system ka naksha bana diya. Charles Wood ne 1854 mein Dalhousie ke time ye bheja, isliye ise 'Magna Carta of English Education in India' kehte hain. Isne kaha: chhote bachche apni bhasha mein padhein, bade college mein English. Calcutta, Bombay, Madras ki universities 1857 mein London University jaisi bani. Baad mein Hunter (1882, Ripon), Raleigh (1902, Curzon), Sadler (1917-19) jaise commissions aaye jo check karte rahe ki padhai kaisi chal rahi hai.
easy.trick: 'Wood ne Despatch bheja, Dalhousie ne daak li' - 1854. Commissions ka order: 'Hunter Raja Sadak par' = Hunter 1882, Raleigh 1902, Sadler 1917.

easy.title: English in Independent India: Language Policy
easy.story: Azadi ke baad sawal tha - desh ki official bhasha kya ho? Constitution ke Article 343 ne kaha Hindi Devanagari mein, aur English sirf 15 saal aur. Lekin South India, khaas kar Tamil Nadu, mein virodh hua, to Official Languages Act 1963 ne English ko saath-saath chalne diya. Schools ke liye Three-Language Formula aaya - jaise ghar mein Hindi, school mein English, aur ek aur Indian bhasha. Hyderabad mein English teachers ke liye CIE (1958) bana jo aaj EFLU hai. NEP 2020 kehta hai Class 5 tak mother tongue mein padhao.
easy.trick: '343 = Hindi, 348 = Court ki English' - 3-4-3 mein beech mein 4 hai jaise Hindi beech mein; 1963 Act = 'English ko extension mila'.

easy.title: Indian English as a Variety
easy.story: Jaise mummy ki dal aur dhabe ki dal dono dal hain par swad alag, waise hi British English aur Indian English dono English hain par flavour alag. Indian English ek 'variety' hai jo humare court, school, akhbaar mein chalti hai. Braj Kachru ne kaha ye galti nahi, apni pehchan hai - isse 'nativization' kehte hain. Raja Rao ne Kanthapura ke Foreword mein likha ki apni aatma ko paraayi bhasha mein kehna padta hai. Kamala Das ne kaha meri English adhi English adhi Indian hai, par imaandar hai. Hobson-Jobson (1886) ek purani dictionary hai jismein Anglo-Indian shabd hain.
easy.trick: 'Kachru ne kaha - kachcha nahi, pakka Indian English!' Hobson-Jobson ke liye: 'Yule-Burnell ne 1886 mein Hobson-Jobson ka jhola bhara'.

easy.title: Kachru's Three Concentric Circles and Models of World Englishes
easy.story: Ek pathar talaab mein phenko to teen gol ghere bante hain - Kachru ka model bhi aisa hi hai. Beech wala Inner Circle: UK, USA jahan English maa-boli hai; ye niyam banate hain (norm-providing). Doosra Outer Circle: India, Nigeria, Singapore jahan English angrezon se aayi aur official kaam mein chalti hai; ye apne niyam bana rahe hain (norm-developing). Teesra Expanding Circle: China, Japan jahan English foreign language hai; ye doosron ke niyam maante hain (norm-dependent). Schneider ne 2003 mein Dynamic Model diya jismein paanch phases hain.
easy.trick: 'I-O-E = Provide, Develop, Depend' - 'India Outer mein Develop karta hai'. Schneider ke phases: 'Fir Ek Nayi Engine Dauri' = Foundation, Exonormative, Nativization, Endonormative, Differentiation.

easy.title: Features of Indian English: Sounds, Grammar and Vocabulary
easy.story: Indian English bolne ka apna andaaz hai. Hum 'thin' ko 'tin' jaisa bolte hain aur 'v' aur 'w' mein fark kam karte hain. Grammar mein hum har jagah 'isn't it?' laga dete hain, 'today itself' aur 'like that only' bolte hain, aur 'hot hot chai' jaisi doubling karte hain. Humne naye shabd bhi banaye: prepone, cousin-brother, do the needful, eve-teasing. Aur humare shabd English mein chale gaye: bungalow, jungle, pyjama, shampoo, thug, guru. Hindi-English mix ko Hinglish kehte hain, jaise 'Yeh Dil Maange More'.
easy.trick: 'Prepone karo, today itself, hot hot chai, isn't it?' - ek line mein chaaron feature: coinage, emphatic itself, reduplication, invariant tag.

easy.title: Beginnings of Indian Writing in English (1794-1900)
easy.story: Socho pehli baar kisi Indian ne English mein diary likhi - wo the Sake Dean Mahomet, 1794 mein 'Travels'. Phir Calcutta ke young teacher Derozio aaye jo Hindu College mein padhate the aur desh par sonnet likhte the; 22 saal mein hi chal base. Krishna Mohan Banerjee ne pehla English play 'The Persecuted' (1831) likha. Bankim ne pehla English novel 'Rajmohan's Wife' (1864) likha, phir Bangla mein likhne lage. Toru Dutt ne French kavitaon ka anuvaad kiya aur 'Our Casuarina Tree' likhi - sirf 21 saal ki umar mein chali gayi.
easy.trick: '94 ki yatra, 27 ke Poems, 31 ka Play, 64 ka Novel' - D-D-B-B: Dean, Derozio, Banerjee, Bankim.

easy.title: Poetry before Independence: Tagore, Naidu, Aurobindo
easy.story: Ye teen bade naam hain jinhone azadi se pehle English kavita ko duniya tak pahunchaya. Tagore ne apni Bangla kavitaon ka English 'Gitanjali' (1912) banaya, Yeats ne introduction likha, aur 1913 mein Nobel mila - pehla Asian. Sarojini Naidu 'Nightingale of India' kehlayi; unki 'Golden Threshold' (1905) mein palki uthane wale, bunkar, Hyderabad ka bazaar - sab rangeen tasveerein hain. Sri Aurobindo ne 'Savitri' likhi, Mahabharata ki Savitri-Satyavan katha par 24,000 lines ki lambi epic, blank verse mein.
easy.trick: 'Gita-Nobel-Yeats' = 1912-13; 'Naidu ki Golden Chidiya' = Golden Threshold, Bird of Time, Broken Wing; 'Aurobindo ki Savitri, lambi jaise rail gaadi'.

easy.title: Modern Indian English Poetry (1950 onwards)
easy.story: 1952 mein Nissim Ezekiel ki 'A Time to Change' aayi aur modern poetry shuru hui - jaise naya season. Ezekiel ne Bombay ki zindagi aur 'Night of the Scorpion' jaisi kavita likhi, aur Indian English ka mazaak bhi udaya. A.K. Ramanujan ne parivaar aur yaadon par likha, aur Tamil-Kannada kavitaon ka anuvaad bhi kiya. Kamala Das ne aurat ke mann ki baat bina daro likhi. Jayanta Mahapatra pehle English poet the jinhe Sahitya Akademi mila (Relationship). Arun Kolatkar ki 'Jejuri' ek mandir-shahar ki yatra hai. P. Lal ne 1958 mein Writers Workshop khola.
easy.trick: 'EZ-RAM-KAMAL-MAHA-KOLA' = Ezekiel, Ramanujan, Kamala Das, Mahapatra, Kolatkar; 'Mahapatra ka Rishta (Relationship) pehla Akademi wala'.

easy.title: Fiction: The Big Three - Anand, Narayan, Raja Rao
easy.story: Ye teen dost jaise teen alag dukaan wale hain. Mulk Raj Anand ki dukaan gareebon ka dard bechti hai - Bakha jhaadu wala (Untouchable), Munoo (Coolie). R.K. Narayan ki dukaan ek chhote shahar Malgudi ki mithi kahaniyan - Swami, Raju guide, Margayya, Jagan mithai wala. Raja Rao ki dukaan darshan aur Gandhi - Kanthapura gaon ki katha ek budhi Achakka sunati hai. Narayan ki 'The Guide' pehla English novel tha jise Sahitya Akademi mila (1960).
easy.trick: 'Anand = Andolan (social), Narayan = Nagar Malgudi (comedy), Raja Rao = Rishi (philosophy)'. Saal: 'Untouchable aur Swami dono 1935 mein paida hue, Kanthapura 1938'.

easy.title: Fiction 1940s-1980s
easy.story: Azadi ke aas paas ke novel jaise purane album ki photos hain. Ahmed Ali ki 'Twilight in Delhi' purani Dilli ki dhalti shaam dikhati hai. Bhabani Bhattacharya ka 'So Many Hungers!' Bengal ke akaal ka dard hai. Kamala Markandaya ki 'Nectar in a Sieve' mein kisan aurat Rukmani hai. Khushwant Singh ka 'Train to Pakistan' Partition ke waqt Mano Majra gaon ki kahani hai. Anita Desai ne aurat ke andar ke akelepan par likha, aur Jhabvala ko 'Heat and Dust' par 1975 ka Booker mila.
easy.trick: 'Twilight 40, Hungers 47, Hatterr 48, Nectar 54, Train 56' - 'Shaam, Bhookh, Hatterr, Shahad, Train' ki kahani banao.

easy.title: Contemporary Fiction: Rushdie and After
easy.story: 1981 mein Rushdie ka 'Midnight's Children' aaya aur jaise Indian English novel ne naya rang pakda - jadoo bhara realism aur chutney jaisi bhasha. Iska hero Saleem Sinai thik 15 August 1947 ki aadhi raat ko paida hota hai. Phir Vikram Seth ka mota novel 'A Suitable Boy', Amitav Ghosh ka 'The Shadow Lines', Arundhati Roy ka 'The God of Small Things' (Booker 1997) aaye. Kiran Desai (2006) aur Aravind Adiga (2008) ne bhi Booker jeeta. Ghosh 2018 mein Jnanpith paane wale pehle English writer bane.
easy.trick: Booker ladder: 'Ruth-Rushdie-Roy-Desai-Adiga' = 75, 81, 97, 06, 08 - 'R-R-R-D-A, Ravi Raja Roj Dukaan Aaye'.

easy.title: Indian English and Indian Drama in Translation
easy.story: Indian English drama ek chhota bhai hai, isliye Indian bhashaon ke naatak anuvaad hokar stage par chhaa gaye. Girish Karnad ne Kannada mein likh kar khud English mein kiya - Tughlaq, Hayavadana, Naga-Mandala. Vijay Tendulkar ne Marathi mein 'Silence! The Court Is in Session' aur 'Ghashiram Kotwal' diye. Badal Sircar ne Bengali mein 'Evam Indrajit' aur 'Third Theatre' diya - galiyon mein bina bade stage ka natak. Mahesh Dattani seedha English mein likhte hain aur Sahitya Akademi paane wale pehle English playwright bane.
easy.trick: 'Karnad-Kannada, Tendulkar-Marathi, Sircar-Bangla, Rakesh-Hindi, Dattani-English' - 'K-K, T-M, S-B, R-H, D-E' jaise jodi wale chappal.

easy.title: Translation in India: History and Theory
easy.story: Translation India mein bahut purana hai, jaise naani ki kahaniyan ek gaon se doosre gaon jaati hain. Panchatantra Pahlavi mein gaya aur Bidpai ki kahani bana. Akbar ke time Mahabharata Persian mein 'Razmnama' bana, aur Dara Shikoh ne Upanishads ka 'Sirr-i-Akbar' kiya. William Jones ne Asiatic Society (1784) banayi aur Shakuntala ka anuvaad kiya; Wilkins ne Gita (1785) ko English mein laaya. Aaj ke theorists jaise G.N. Devy, Sujit Mukherjee aur Tejaswini Niranjana kehte hain translation mein power aur pehchan dono chhupi hain.
easy.trick: 'Wilkins 85 ki Gita, Jones 89 ki Shakuntala' - pehle Gita phir Shakuntala, jaise pehle puja phir prem. 'Niranjana ne Translation ko Site kiya' = Siting Translation.

easy.title: Indian Writing in Translation: Key Texts
easy.story: Jaise achhi mithai doosre shahar bhejni ho to dabbe mein pack karte hain, waise hi bhasha ki kitaabein translation ke dabbe mein duniya tak jaati hain. Ananthamurthy ki Kannada 'Samskara' ko Ramanujan ne English mein kiya. Mahasweta Devi ki 'Draupadi' ko Spivak ne. Dalit lekhakon - Bama (Karukku, Tamil), Omprakash Valmiki (Joothan, Hindi), Limbale (Akkarmashi, Marathi) - ne apna dard likha. Geetanjali Shree ki 'Ret Samadhi' Daisy Rockwell ke anuvaad 'Tomb of Sand' ke roop mein 2022 ka International Booker jeeti, aur Banu Mushtaq ki 'Heart Lamp' ne 2025 mein.
easy.trick: 'Samskara-Ramanujan, Draupadi-Spivak, Karukku-Holmstrom, Tomb-Rockwell, Heart-Bhasthi' - 'Ram ne Spice di, Holmes ne Rock pe Basti banayi'.

easy.title: Sahitya Akademi and Literary Awards
easy.story: Sahitya Akademi desh ka sahitya wala school hai jo har saal achhi kitaabon ko inaam deta hai. Ye 1954 mein shuru hua aur Nehru iske pehle President the. Ye 24 bhashaon ko maanta hai - 22 schedule wali plus English aur Rajasthani. Jnanpith sabse bada sahitya award hai; pehla 1965 mein G. Sankara Kurup ko mila. Booker, Nobel, JCB, DSC jaise awards bhi NET mein pooche jaate hain.
easy.trick: '22+2 = 24' (English + Rajasthani); 'Nehru ne 54 mein Akademi ka darwaza khola'; pehle winners: 'Kurup-Jnanpith, Bachchan-Saraswati, Naqvi-DSC, Benyamin-JCB'.

easy.title: Criticism, Histories and Futures of Indian English
easy.story: Jaise cricket ke scorer itihaas likhte hain, waise hi critics ne Indian English sahitya ka itihaas likha. K.R. Srinivasa Iyengar ne 1943 mein 'Indo-Anglian Literature' aur 1962 mein 'Indian Writing in English' likhi. M.K. Naik ne History likhi, Meenakshi Mukherjee ne 'The Twice Born Fiction'. Gauri Viswanathan ne bataya ki English literature ki padhai angrezon ka control ka hathiyar thi. Aage ka future: Hinglish, digital English, aur bhasha sahitya ke translations ka badhta zor.
easy.trick: 'Iyengar ne naam rakha Indo-Anglian (43), Naik ne History (82), Meenakshi ne Twice Born (71)' - 'I-N-M = Itihaas Na Mitao'.

quotes.quote: A single shelf of a good European library was worth the whole native literature of India and Arabia.

We must at present do our best to form a class who may be interpreters between us and the millions whom we govern; a class of persons, Indian in blood and colour, but English in taste, in opinions, in morals, and in intellect.

All the historical information which has been collected from all the books written in the Sanskrit language is less valuable than what may be found in the most paltry abridgments used at preparatory schools in England.

The great object of the British Government ought to be the promotion of European literature and science amongst the natives of India; and all the funds appropriated for the purpose of education would be best employed on English education alone.
quotes.source: English Education Act, Resolution of 7 March 1835

quotes.quote: The education which we desire to see extended in India is that which has for its object the diffusion of the improved arts, science, philosophy and literature of Europe; in short, of European knowledge.
To give millions a knowledge of English is to enslave them.
One has to convey in a language that is not one's own the spirit that is one's own.
English is not really an alien language to us. It is the language of our intellectual make-up, like Sanskrit or Persian was before, but not of our emotional make-up.
We cannot write like the English. We should not. We cannot write only as Indians.
Our method of expression therefore has to be a dialect which will some day prove to be as distinctive and colourful as the Irish or the American.
There is no village in India, however mean, that has not a rich sthala-purana, or legendary history, of its own.
The tempo of Indian life must be infused into our English expression.
Episode follows episode, and when our thoughts stop our breath stops, and we move on to another thought. This was and still is the ordinary style of our story-telling.
I am Indian, very brown, born in Malabar, I speak three languages, write in two, dream in one.
The language I speak becomes mine, its distortions, its queernesses all mine, mine alone. It is half English, half Indian, funny perhaps, but it is honest.
Don't write in English, they said, English is not your mother-tongue.
I am sinner, I am saint.
I have made my commitments now. This is one: to stay where I am.
I went to Roman Catholic school, a mugging Jew among the wolves.
I remember the night my mother was stung by a scorpion.
quotes.source: Night of the Scorpion, The Exact Name, 1965

quotes.quote: Home is where we have to gather grace.
The best poets wait for words.
quotes.source: Poet, Lover, Birdwatcher, The Exact Name, 1965

quotes.quote: Friends, our dear sister is departing for foreign in two three days.
quotes.source: Goodbye Party for Miss Pushpa T.S., Hymns in Darkness, 1976

quotes.quote: I am standing for peace and non-violence.
quotes.source: The Patriot (Very Indian Poems in Indian English), Hymns in Darkness, 1976

quotes.quote: I was born in the city of Bombay ... once upon a time.
At the precise instant of India's arrival at independence, I tumbled forth into the world.
I had been mysteriously handcuffed to history, my destinies indissolubly chained to those of my country.
To conquer English may be to complete the process of making ourselves free.
quotes.source: 'Commonwealth Literature' Does Not Exist, in Imaginary Homelands, 1991

quotes.quote: It may be that writers in my position, exiles or emigrants or expatriates, are haunted by some sense of loss.

The prose writing created in this period by Indian writers working in English is proving to be a stronger and more important body of work than most of what has been produced in the 16 'official languages' of India.
quotes.source: Introduction, The Vintage Book of Indian Writing 1947-1997, 1997

quotes.quote: Our village - I don't think you have ever heard about it - Kanthapura is its name, and it is in the province of Kara.
The outcastes' colony was a group of mud-walled houses that clustered together in two rows, under the shadow of the town and the cantonment.
It was Monday morning. Swaminathan was reluctant to open his eyes.
Raju welcomed the intrusion - something to relieve the loneliness of the place.
The summer of 1947 was not like other Indian summers.
May in Ayemenem is a hot, brooding month.
quotes.source: The God of Small Things, 1997 (opening line)

quotes.quote: The Love Laws. That lay down who should be loved, and how. And how much.
Mr. Premier, Sir. Neither you nor I speak English, but there are some things that can be said only in English.
You too will marry a boy I choose, said Mrs Rupa Mehra firmly to her younger daughter.
My country! in thy day of glory past a beauteous halo circled round thy brow.
quotes.source: To India - My Native Land, Poems, 1827

quotes.quote: Like a huge Python, winding round and round the rugged trunk.
quotes.source: Our Casuarina Tree, Ancient Ballads and Legends of Hindustan, 1882

quotes.quote: Lightly, O lightly we bear her along, she sways like a flower in the wind of our song.
Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high.
I resemble everyone but myself.
To the memory of the British Empire in India, which conferred subjecthood on us but withheld citizenship.
quotes.source: Dedication, The Autobiography of an Unknown Indian, 1951

quotes.quote: At the stroke of the midnight hour, when the world sleeps, India will awake to life and freedom.

Article 343 makes Hindi in Devanagari script the official language of the Union.
The Official Languages Act of 1963 ended the use of English for official purposes.
The Kothari Commission submitted its report in 1949.

It was issued after the Hunter Commission.
